notes:
— Background: StratusBridge is a mid-market analytics SaaS (product metrics + anomaly detection). Currently on OpenAI for chat + embeddings; infra team has some in-house caching. Evaluation path: Hosted API → Dedicated. Interested in predictable cost and local VPC for sensitive customer telemetry.

— Primary asks (from PM + Eng):
  • Migrate existing chat/triage bot and doc-search embedding index to Redwood with minimal prompt/regression risk.
  • Maintain prompt parity for summarization pipeline (they have 120 curated prompts/test-cases).
  • Support SSO (SAML) for admin console + audit logs and KMS for customer-keyed data.

— Timeline / recent activity:
  • 2026-02-12: Intro call (Jordan) — High-level requirements, current token volumes ~120M/mo; latency p95 target < 250ms for chat small-burst workloads.
  • 2026-02-18: Tech deep-dive (Aisha) — discussed Dedicated sizing, GPU families, and routing/fallback. (Fireflies ff-20260218-7321).
  • 2026-02-25: Sent pricing draft + sample commit tiers (drive: POC pricing deck).
  • 2026-03-02: POC kickoff — delivered compatibility shim to map current SDK calls to Redwood Hosted endpoints; initial smoke tests run (Fireflies ff-20260302-9923).
  • 2026-03-08: POC regression run #1 — 12/120 prompts showed distributional drift on summarization, likely tokenization + system message handling differences. Logged RED-9123.
  • 2026-03-10: Security questionnaire submitted; awaiting SAML cert exchange and KMS integration steps. Logged RED-9217.

— POC details / technical notes:
  • Approach: run 2-phase POC — Phase A (Hosted API) reproduce production traffic and validate prompt parity / cost delta; Phase B (Dedicated) sizing run and SLA verification.
  • Compatibility shim: simple wrapper that rewrites SDK calls and injects Redwood system tokens. Works for generate/chat/embeddings but needs edge-case handling for function-calling and streaming.
  • Regression patterns: longer summaries truncate in ~20% of failing cases; hypothesis: model variant differences and prompt truncation due to prefix tokenization. Proposed fixes: small prompt rework, explicit stop tokens, and try Redwood-verified model variants.
  • Observability: asked for route-level latency breakdowns and per-token cost for mixed workloads. They want token-level billing export to BI.

— Pricing / commercial notes:
  • Initial ARR target: $75k–$200k depending on committed throughput.
  • Open question: Dedicated discount tiers and overage behavior during spikes. Need legal on SLA clause for failover to hosted.
  • They requested a 90-day eval credit for Dedicated sizing run.

— Security & compliance:
  • Must pass SAML SSO test, provide SOC2 report (they asked about ISO27001 but it's lower priority), KMS integration for customer-scoped keys, retention-configurable audit logs.
  • Data residency: some EU customers — will want region pinning for embeddings index.

— Quotes / verbatim from stakeholders:
  • "We need zero surprises on output quality — even small regressions cause product churn." — Head of Product.
  • "If we can prove parity on Hosted in 2 weeks, we'll fast-track Dedicated procurement." — Engineering Manager.

— Next steps (short):
  1) Aisha to deliver parity regression report with diffs on failing prompts (due 2026-03-16).
  2) Jordan to schedule Dedicated pricing review with Finance (target week of 2026-03-22).
  3) Security: exchange SAML cert and schedule KMS integration workshop (Naomi to join).

— Risks / open blockers (shorthand):
  • prompt parity regressions — need engineering time to triage
  • compat layer edge cases (streaming + function-call)
  • cost model for Dedicated vs burst on Hosted (budget)
  • data residency confirmation for EU customer subset

— Internal notes for AE/SE:
  • Bring model-variant comparison table and tokenization notes to next tech call.
  • Consider proposal: small Dedicated pool + fallback to Hosted to reduce upfront commit.
